question: GQ-010
action: independent re-derivation of a live claim from the source graph, not from its own metrics file
why: Six of seven live claims ground ONLY in metrics files this agent wrote. That is self-referential evidence: re-deriving the metric confirms the metric, not the position. GQ-010 asserts stars and dependence "diverge by orders of magnitude" while grounding in two numbers that show neither divergence nor a comparison.

independent_test.population: 498 repos carrying BOTH stars_observed and dependent_repos

verdict: CONFIRMED, and the claim was UNDER-evidenced. Only 8 of 50 repos appear in both top-50 lists, and 20 of the 50 most-starred have zero dependents. vuejs/vue at 209,864 stars has 0 dependents while emoji-regex at 1,909 stars has 4,193,583 — the rankings are nearly disjoint, which is a stronger statement than "diverge by orders of magnitude".
what_this_is_not: Not independent REVIEW. I re-derived my own claim from the source, which removes the self-reference but not the single reviewer. A second party could still find a flaw in the query.

independent_test.overlap_top50.query: with b as (select distinct content_ref cr, json_extract(meta_json,'$.stars_observed') s, json_extract(meta_json,'$.dependent_repos') d from person_content where domain='github' and json_extract(meta_json,'$.dependent_repos') is not null and json_extract(meta_json,'$.stars_observed') is not null), ts as (select cr from b order by s desc limit 50), td as (select cr from b order by d desc limit 50) select (select count(*) from ts where cr in (select cr from td));
